final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS overall_avg FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ordersmark, s1.avg_remain, s1.avg_remain - s2.overall_avg AS difference FROM s1 CROSS JOIN s2 WHERE s2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s1.avg_remain > s2.overall_avg), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS upper_avg FROM s3) SELECT AVG(s3.avg_remain), AVG(s3.difference), AVG(s3.avg_remain - s4.upper_avg) FROM s3 CROSS JOIN s4 WHERE s4.upper_avg IS NOT NULL AND s3.avg_remain > s4.upper_avg
